prompt:
Create ONE production-ready transparent sprite atlas of SIXTEEN charming detective-game UI icons, precisely arranged in a 4 column by 4 row grid. Square canvas. All 16 cells equal size. Each icon isolated, centered in its own cell, takes up around 80-84% of the cell, with clear transparent gutters, no touching neighboring cells. True alpha transparency everywhere around the objects, not white or beige paper, no checkerboard drawn into the picture. No grid lines, tile backgrounds, badges, border boxes or enclosing circles. Reference mood: the cozy, curious, vintage puzzle-adventure charm of Professor Layton, reinterpreted as soft handmade wax-crayon and colored-pencil illustrations on transparent background. Original prop designs, no character likenesses or logos. Simplified thick warm dark-brown pencil contours, dry crayon grain within the color fills, soft restrained shading, round slightly irregular forms, clever toy-like proportions, silhouettes easily readable at 32 pixels. Palette: warm cream, honey ochre, dusty sage, muted coral, mist blue. These are small functional icons, not detailed paintings. No text, no letters, no numbers. Exact reading order left-to-right, top-to-bottom:
ROW 1: (1) STORY: an open cream illustrated storybook with coral fabric spine and bookmark, a simple tiny blue crescent and gold star drawn on its pages; (2) JOURNAL: a closed sage-green detective notebook, brass clasp and one short ochre pencil attached diagonally, visibly different from the open storybook; (3) MAP: a cream three-fold paper map with a simple sage winding path and one large coral map pin; (4) SETTINGS: a chunky warm brass cogwheel, cream center hole, playful but unmistakable gear silhouette.
ROW 2: (5) OVERVIEW: a squat pair of dusty blue vintage binoculars with dark lenses and small brass highlights, three-quarter front view; (6) RETURN TO HALL: one tiny cream guesthouse with honey roof, green front door and softly rounded chimney, welcoming cottage silhouette; (7) HINT: one glowing honey-yellow glass lightbulb with a short brass base and three short hand-drawn rays, no question mark; (8) EXAMINE: one large round detective magnifying glass with a warm wood handle and pale-blue glass.
ROW 3: (9) VOICE: a rounded vintage brass microphone with a simple sage handle/stand and two broad grille strokes, not headphones; (10) SEND: a single folded cream-and-coral paper airplane pointing up and to the right; (11) NEXT: one simple broad sage right-pointing arrow shaped as a cute wooden pointer, no signpost pole; (12) CLOSE: a bold coral X, two thick crayon strokes, no button frame.
ROW 4: (13) CONFIRM: a single broad sage-green check mark, crayon drawn, no surrounding circle; (14) EVIDENCE: a small honey manila evidence folder with a single cream photo corner and one red paperclip, no writing or stamps; (15) CONVERSATION: two overlapping rounded speech bubbles, one mist blue and one cream, tiny tails, blank inside; (16) REST: a pale honey crescent moon hugging one small dusty-blue cloud, with one tiny star.
Consistency is essential: all icons have similar visual weight and scale, clean simple silhouettes, sparse details, no photorealistic light, no glossy 3D plastic, no flat corporate vector aesthetic. Transparent background required.
